orientation_convention: source axes +X=patient left, -X=patient right, +Y=posterior, +Z=base/superior, -Z=apex/inferior; AR export rotates 180 degrees about the source Z axis (proper rotation, determinant +1) to +X=patient right, -X=patient left, +Y=anterior/screen-up, -Y=posterior/screen-down, -Z=apex/front/user side, +Z=base/back
ablr_markers: A=apex/front, B=base/back, R=patient right (+X), L=patient left (-X); R/L sit on the true patient sides, so in the apex-facing lithotomy view R reads viewer-left and L viewer-right; on by default; hide nodes/meshes named orientation_* or AR_orientation_markers to toggle

triangle_budget.reason: 30k-80k triangles keeps phone AR smooth while preserving gland/zonal shape.
